digest.component_or_area: provider-parity evaluation corpus and verdict scoring
propositions: The code-review-verify spec output carries no decision polarity (emits only verifications list), causing _verdict_decision to fall through to advisory for all cases regardless of gold label
The V-real-defect gold-block case is guaranteed a recall miss on both standard and frontier arms because both verify cases are mis-scored as advisory
Naive fix of mapping non-empty verifications list to block would correct the recall miss but simultaneously mis-score the clean case V-clean-rename as block, manufacturing a false accept

code-review-verify must be excluded from the parity corpus via a separate named mechanism (POLARITY_FREE_SOLVERS) distinct from AGENTIC_SOLVERS to preserve the exclusion reason and prevent future silent re-admission
After exclusion, n_gold reduces from 28 to 26 (still above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS floor of 20) and recall improves on both arms without changing any gating verdicts
The bedrock arm true recall is 1.000 not 0.929, correcting measurement accuracy for the S6 epic that measures bedrock performance
